note: Hand-labelled synthetic project memories; no production conversations. Retrieval relevance, not fact-equivalence labels.

documents.name: Package manager
documents.text: This repository installs dependencies with npm and commits package-lock.json.

documents.name: Release approval
documents.text: Publishing a package requires the owner's explicit approval.

documents.name: 本地数据
documents.text: 用户希望记忆向量在本机生成，聊天内容不能传到外部服务。

documents.name: Paid run budget
documents.text: A paid model experiment must stop when its single-run cost reaches three yuan.

documents.name: Memory storage
documents.text: Workspace memory is stored in the .dsh/trivium.tdb file.

documents.name: Uninstall
documents.text: Removing the plugin deletes its workspace memory; upgrading with add preserves it.

documents.name: 召回默认值
documents.text: 自动召回默认关闭，用户启用后才会向对话注入记忆。

documents.name: 记忆芯片
documents.text: 芯片是用户勾选的记忆白名单，下一轮会优先注入这些条目。

documents.name: Concurrent writers
documents.text: When another process holds the workspace write lock, edits return 409 and leave the original fact intact.

documents.name: Independent snapshot
documents.text: A snapshot pins an immutable database generation so external readers can query without opening the live writer.

documents.name: Live query
documents.text: Live reads use the host's already-open handle and see changes made since the last snapshot.

documents.name: Query timeout recovery
documents.text: An expensive query is cancelled at its deadline; a later small query can still succeed.

documents.name: Batch persistence
documents.text: Combining eight archive actions into one flush avoids eight synchronous persistence calls.

documents.name: Lightweight payload reads
documents.text: Use getPayload to inspect metadata without materializing a 1536-dimensional vector.

documents.name: Request correlation
documents.text: The gateway propagates X-Request-Id to correlate a request across services.

documents.name: AuthGateway
documents.text: AuthGateway validates login tokens and forwards authenticated requests.

documents.name: Retry count
documents.text: The upload worker retries a failed transfer at most three times.

documents.name: Mail retries
documents.text: The mail sender retries a failed delivery at most five times.

documents.name: Automatic release
documents.text: Automatic publishing is forbidden; the owner approves every public release.

documents.name: Sandbox publishing
documents.text: The isolated test registry permits automatic publishing of disposable fixtures.

documents.name: 事实有效期
documents.text: 超过 untilAt 的事实已经失效，普通当前事实查询应排除它。

documents.name: Decision history
documents.text: A confirmed supersedes edge points from the new decision to the old one; only the newest head is current.

documents.name: 拒绝替换
documents.text: 拒绝替换后，两个事实保持原样，并追加一行 supersede-rejected 审计记录。

documents.name: Partial import
documents.text: If import fails after some nodes were committed, report the confirmed count or unknown count and a retry hint.

documents.name: Embedding contract
documents.text: An embedding must contain exactly 1536 finite numeric values; wrong dimensions are rejected.

documents.name: Query instruction
documents.text: The GTE instruction prefix is added to retrieval questions, while document passages remain unprefixed.

documents.name: Offline regression
documents.text: Smoke tests use controlled providers and never call a paid model endpoint.

documents.name: 孤立实体
documents.text: 孤立实体没有任何 about、decided、broke 或 fixed 业务关系，工作区归属边不算。

documents.name: One-hop relationships
documents.text: One-hop lookup lists directly connected business nodes in the selected direction, without recursively expanding a second hop.

documents.name: Runtime
documents.text: The plugin supports Node 22.19 or newer compatible releases, and Node 24.

documents.name: Kernel pin
documents.text: TriviumDB is pinned at version 0.9.0 for reproducible measurements.

documents.name: 界面偏好
documents.text: 设置页跟随宿主的明暗主题，小窗口中的输入框应自动换行。

documents.name: Ollama endpoint
documents.text: The local Ollama HTTP service normally listens on port 11434.

documents.name: Query admission
documents.text: A third simultaneous snapshot query is refused with a busy response until a worker is free.

documents.name: File permissions
documents.text: Settings containing a provider credential are written with owner-only permissions on supported systems.

documents.name: Workspace isolation
documents.text: Node IDs are scoped to a workspace; a request must keep the workspace selected when the action was created.
